lines.text: I heard a scream for help while falling with my headlights off.
It was a type of silent scream a trap lover makes to
escape a pending marriage,
a concussion,
a set of walls caving inward, seething and simmering,
and a solitude of crowds and smiles.

It was a type of silent call a man makes to the
mirror after midnight.
To digest the truth,
a windless insomnia and epiphany of a road winding down.
After a day of life dilated at the sun as long and
as wise as possible,
we won't make it.
